methodology: paired patient-cluster bootstrap, patient and backend balanced
bootstrap_unit: patient including every backend, image and correlated query from that patient
interval_scope: descriptive conditional intervals, no multiplicity adjustment or population/clinical guarantee
risk_definition: R is aggregate W/C, not mean of per-image or per-patient ratios
delta_units: G/W/C/R in fractions, multiply by100 for percentage points

selection_rule.interpretation: development operating gates, not confidence bounds

data_limit: same renderer and fixed old detector, new patients do not establish external real-photo generalization

counts.fallback_count_note: Runner fallback includes repeating a rejected B0 construction when the refiner already left points unchanged. Total is not the number of new refinement failures.
counts.timing_scope: geometry construction including refinement, excludes detector and RGB sampling

common_support_error.aggregation: pool squared residuals within each patient/backend, then equally weight patients and backends
common_support_error.scope: conditional on nonempty common support, with missing groups explicitly counted
